response.sql:
WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_item_average_ratios,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_of_item_line_item_counts
FROM per_item;

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined and is treated as a missing ratio; AVG ignores it, as it does NULL ratios. Each invoice line item row is counted once.
